result.topic_en: Numerical roots of the seventh-degree equation x^7 - 28x^4 + 76.19031634 = 0 (three real, four complex), with logarithms of their moduli, their arguments in degrees, and a check that the roots sum to zero and that the sum of the log-moduli equals the log of the constant term.

methods.what: Numerical solution of a trinomial-type seventh-degree equation, giving all seven roots (real and complex)
Logarithms of root moduli with sign flag n and arguments of complex roots in degrees
Check: sum of roots equals zero (vanishing x^6 coefficient)
Check: sum of logarithms of root moduli equals log of the constant term (product of roots)
